title: Rav Zilberstein Visits Yerushalayim
body: Rav Yitzchok Zilberstein, rov of Ramat Elchanan, visited Yerushalayim for a grandson's wedding and stopped by his brother-in-law Rav Binyomin Dovid Elyashiv's home.

title: Satmar Philanthropist Hosts Sheva Brachos
body: Satmar Rebbe attends sheva brachos hosted by philanthropist Mr. Yoeli Landau in Williamsburg, honoring the wedding of his grandson. The event is dedicated to the orphans of the Satmar community.
